Reading the answer, the only directory under `src/` that it says contains code calling into llama.cpp is `src/inference/`. It also names `src/inference/adapters/`, where `adapter_registry.cpp` uses llama.cpp's `common_chat`. `include/entropic/inference/` is not under `src/`, so I left it out.

ITEMS:
src/inference/
src/inference/adapters/
END
